title: Blackout Manor
description: A stormy night. A locked estate. Eight guests and a dead host. The power is out, the killer is still in the house — and everyone has something to hide.

meta.disclaimer: This is a work of fiction. All characters and events are invented for storytelling purposes.

setting.time: A stormy Friday night in autumn
setting.atmosphere: Isolated Victorian manor with no power, flickering candles, and locked doors

win_text_rule: Name the killer, weapon, and room — and prove it with evidence from the conversation.

characters.name: Eleanor Voss
characters.motive: Protecting a dark family secret about the estate's inheritance
characters.tells: Pauses before answering questions about the east wing

character_self_knowledge: You have served Hargreave Manor for thirty years.
You were the last person to see Lord Hargreave alive — in the east wing study.
You know the secret passage behind the fireplace in the library.

canonical_facts.content: Lord Hargreave was found dead in the east wing study at 9:15 PM.
A heavy silver candlestick is missing from the mantelpiece in the east wing study.
